title: Unified PowerBuilder
author: BasedChad69
desc:
A thick old man record holding powerlifter had a lovechild with a long since passed beloved IFBB pro; in turn we get this amazing concoction of skin rippling pumps and mind splitting heavy lifts. 

This program recommends bands btw

It is split up into 3 blocks, with a focus on building up dynamic lifts and max effort lifts.  It varies between movements pretty decently to avoid overuse.  It will fatigue you heavy, we recommend an intra workout drink during the program.  if you know the ebook I highly recommend following along with it.  

The program is meant to be ran 5 days in a row with 2 rest days at the end of the week.  You can vary this but I recommend FOLLOWING THE PROGRAM TO A TEE, if you want real gains.
